attachments.origin_landmark: anterior tubercles of the transverse processes C3-C6
attachments.insertion_landmark: basilar part of the occipital bone

actions: flexes the head on the neck

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population

neuromuscular_junction_zone.location_description: mid-belly endplate band -- for where this band lies along the muscle, see motor_endplate_zones

functional_compartments.function_note: Lies directly on the prevertebral fascia in the retropharyngeal plane -- the muscle a retropharyngeal abscess displaces forward.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: INDR4a. Proximal of two nerve-dense regions, about 1.99 cm2, from the C1 and C2 branches. NOT recommended as a target: puncture simulation found the approach misdirected and at risk of damaging the submandibular gland.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation

motor_endplate_zones.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology
motor_endplate_zones.notes: INDR4b. Distal of two, about 4.5 cm2, from the C3 branch -- the largest nerve-dense region measured in the deep cervical group, and the one with the highest muscle-spindle abundance of all five muscles studied. Centre of highest abundance at 47.28% of muscle length, in its middle third. This is the recommended target.
motor_endplate_zones.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation

injection_target_points.label: centre of the region of highest muscle spindle abundance
injection_target_points.transverse_line_from: lowest point of the jugular notch
injection_target_points.longitudinal_line_from: lowest point of the jugular notch
injection_target_points.needle_path: At the level of the hyoid bone, entered anteroinferior to posterosuperior through skin, subcutaneous fat and platysma, passing between the lateral edge of the hyoid bone and the common carotid artery, and angled cranially between the inferolateral edge of the submandibular gland and the medial side of the common carotid.
injection_target_points.method: modified Sihler's stain intramuscular nerve-dense region, with muscle-spindle abundance histology, localised by spiral CT with barium sulphate labelling
injection_target_points.notes: The shallowest angle and the deepest target of the five: 58 degrees to the skin at 3.93 cm. A perpendicular approach is not available because the trachea and oesophagus cover the target anteriorly and the carotid lies lateral to it. Depth is reported by the source in centimetres, as the mean of its own cadaver sample, so unlike a percentage it does not scale with the patient. Treat it as the depth to expect on the screen, not a setting to dial in. Deep cervical muscles sit under complex structures and the source recommends ultrasound guidance for all of them. Divided into two neuromuscular compartments, C1-C2 and C3. The source recommends splitting the muscle flap along this line when it is harvested for palatopharyngeal or soft palate reconstruction. About 2.5 units at this target, the largest of the five, following the region's area.
injection_target_points.source: Wang D, Chen P, Jia F, Wang M, Wu J, Yang S, 'Division of neuromuscular compartments and localization of the center of the highest region of muscle spindles abundance in deep cervical muscles based on Sihler's staining', Front Neuroanat 18:1340468 (2024), doi:10.3389/fnana.2024.1340468 -- 36 adult cadavers, modified Sihler's staining with muscle-spindle histology, cadaveric puncture simulation and spiral CT localisation
